'''Corellia Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]<ref name="SmugglersVanguard" /> and the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Station-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellia Orbital Station appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission "Number One with a Bullet".<ref name="SWTOR" />
